verdict.rationale: CockroachDB speaks the PostgreSQL wire protocol, so PostgreSQL client drivers can connect, and it is described as PostgreSQL-compatible. That suggests Postgres-targeting ORMs could work, but the evidence never shows ORM-specific support or guides. A community comment confirms Postgres clients can be reused but notes compatibility gaps such as missing array columns, so 'out of the box' is not established. Missing for 10: documented integration guides for Prisma, Drizzle, Django, or Rails; evidence of ORM-level compatibility (dialects/adapters, migrations); hands-on corroboration that these frameworks work without workarounds.
